CStrip.what: An Airwindows channel strip: three-band EQ, filters, gate, compressor and micro-delay.
CStrip.sound: Strange and aggressive. Boosting the top adds Energy-style bite. The ButterComp-style compressor has a speed control that can be pushed into artefacts.
CStrip.use: One channel strip that can also do sonic destruction.

controls.Treble: Treble gain. Heavy boosts add aggressive highs.
controls.Gate: Gate amount, with a release that pulls sound back in the picture.
controls.CompSpd: Compressor speed. Keep it low for normal behaviour.
controls.TimeLag: Micro-delay for groove against other tracks.

ConsoleHBuss.what: The ConsoleH buss: tone shaping, filters and threshold for the 2-buss.
ConsoleHBuss.sound: Adaptable and big. Almost everything drops out when flat. Includes a near-clip light and rainbow meter.
ConsoleHBuss.use: On the 2-buss after ConsoleH channels, at unity gain.

ConsoleX2Buss.what: A ConsoleX2 buss with four-band EQ and threshold.
ConsoleX2Buss.sound: Not documented upstream yet. Written from the control names only.
ConsoleX2Buss.use: On the 2-buss in the ConsoleX2 system.

PurestConsole4Buss.sound: Not documented upstream yet. Written from the control names only.
PurestConsole4Buss.use: Console system summing; keep unity gain between channels and buss.

PurestConsole4Channel.sound: Not documented upstream yet. Written from the control names only.
PurestConsole4Channel.use: Console system summing; keep unity gain between channels and buss.

Console9Channel.what: Just the summing from ConsoleX, as a standalone Console9Channel.
Console9Channel.sound: Clean console summing with Discontinuity-style air nonlinearity. Keep unity gain.
Console9Channel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

Console9Buss.what: Just the summing from ConsoleX, as a standalone Console9Buss.
Console9Buss.sound: Clean console summing with Discontinuity-style air nonlinearity. Keep unity gain.
Console9Buss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

ConsoleLAChannel.what: The Airwindows take on the Quad Eight console, the sound of 1970s LA (ConsoleLAChannel).
ConsoleLAChannel.sound: Big, wide, cinematic and enormous headroom. Not flat at neutral.
ConsoleLAChannel.use: Channel plugins on the channels and the Buss on the 2-buss.

ConsoleLABuss.what: The Airwindows take on the Quad Eight console, the sound of 1970s LA (ConsoleLABuss).
ConsoleLABuss.sound: Big, wide, cinematic and enormous headroom. Not flat at neutral.
ConsoleLABuss.use: Channel plugins on the channels and the Buss on the 2-buss.

ConsoleMCChannel.what: The initial, bright take on the MCI console (ConsoleMCChannel).
ConsoleMCChannel.sound: Gnarly analog summing built from Creature, Sinew, ResEQ2, Pear and BitShiftPan. Bright. Not flat at neutral.
ConsoleMCChannel.use: Best at 96k. Channel plugins on channels, Buss on the 2-buss.

controls.MidPeak: Amount of the mid boost (boost only, like the MCI).
controls.Pan: Pan, with a special switching network.
controls.Fader: Fader before the EQ, like the MCI.

ConsoleMCBuss.what: The initial, bright take on the MCI console (ConsoleMCBuss).
ConsoleMCBuss.sound: Gnarly analog summing built from Creature, Sinew, ResEQ2, Pear and BitShiftPan. Bright. Not flat at neutral.
ConsoleMCBuss.use: Best at 96k. Channel plugins on channels, Buss on the 2-buss.

controls.MidPeak: Amount of the mid boost (boost only, like the MCI).
controls.Pan: Pan, with a special switching network.
controls.Fader: Fader before the EQ, like the MCI.

ConsoleMDChannel.what: The tone-shaping take on the classic MCI console (ConsoleMDChannel).
ConsoleMDChannel.sound: Like ConsoleMC without SubTight, with pristine EQ options.
ConsoleMDChannel.use: Best at 96k. Channel plugins on channels, Buss on the 2-buss.

controls.MidPeak: Amount of the mid boost (boost only, like the MCI).
controls.Pan: Pan, with a special switching network.
controls.Fader: Fader before the EQ, like the MCI.

ConsoleMDBuss.what: The tone-shaping take on the classic MCI console (ConsoleMDBuss).
ConsoleMDBuss.sound: Like ConsoleMC without SubTight, with pristine EQ options.
ConsoleMDBuss.use: Best at 96k. Channel plugins on channels, Buss on the 2-buss.

controls.MidPeak: Amount of the mid boost (boost only, like the MCI).
controls.Pan: Pan, with a special switching network.
controls.Fader: Fader before the EQ, like the MCI.

Console8LiteChannel.what: Simplified Console8 with a single mix buss (Console8LiteChannel).
Console8LiteChannel.sound: Console8's ultrasonic filtering, distributed highpass and transformer-style treble softening, in traditional channel-and-buss form.
Console8LiteChannel.use: Channel last on each channel, faders at unity, Buss first on the buss.

Console8LiteBuss.what: Simplified Console8 with a single mix buss (Console8LiteBuss).
Console8LiteBuss.sound: Console8's ultrasonic filtering, distributed highpass and transformer-style treble softening, in traditional channel-and-buss form.
Console8LiteBuss.use: Channel last on each channel, faders at unity, Buss first on the buss.

Console8ChannelIn.what: Console8 Console8ChannelIn: the analog-simulation stage that goes first.
Console8ChannelIn.sound: Subtle, solid and physical. Distributed ultrasonic filtering, highpass and treble softening.
Console8ChannelIn.use: In plugins go FIRST on channels, submixes and the master buss, Out plugins last, with unity gain between.

Console8SubIn.what: Console8 Console8SubIn: the analog-simulation stage that goes first.
Console8SubIn.sound: Subtle, solid and physical. Distributed ultrasonic filtering, highpass and treble softening.
Console8SubIn.use: In plugins go FIRST on channels, submixes and the master buss, Out plugins last, with unity gain between.

Console8BussIn.what: Console8 Console8BussIn: the analog-simulation stage that goes first.
Console8BussIn.sound: Subtle, solid and physical. Distributed ultrasonic filtering, highpass and treble softening.
Console8BussIn.use: In plugins go FIRST on channels, submixes and the master buss, Out plugins last, with unity gain between.

Console8ChannelOut.what: Console8 Console8ChannelOut: the stage that goes last.
Console8ChannelOut.sound: Subtle analog simulation across the channel, submix and buss topology.
Console8ChannelOut.use: Out plugins go LAST on channels, submixes and the master buss.

Console8SubOut.what: Console8 Console8SubOut: the stage that goes last.
Console8SubOut.sound: Subtle analog simulation across the channel, submix and buss topology.
Console8SubOut.use: Out plugins go LAST on channels, submixes and the master buss.

Console8BussOut.what: Console8 Console8BussOut: the stage that goes last.
Console8BussOut.sound: Subtle analog simulation across the channel, submix and buss topology.
Console8BussOut.use: Out plugins go LAST on channels, submixes and the master buss.

Console8ChannelHype.what: A brighter, sparklier swap for the matching Console8 In plugin (Console8ChannelHype).
Console8ChannelHype.sound: Softer and more ethereal than the In plugin. The more stages you replace, the more hyped it gets.
Console8ChannelHype.use: Swap in place of the matching In plugin. No controls.

Console8SubHype.what: A brighter, sparklier swap for the matching Console8 In plugin (Console8SubHype).
Console8SubHype.sound: Softer and more ethereal than the In plugin. The more stages you replace, the more hyped it gets.
Console8SubHype.use: Swap in place of the matching In plugin. No controls.

Console8BussHype.what: A brighter, sparklier swap for the matching Console8 In plugin (Console8BussHype).
Console8BussHype.sound: Softer and more ethereal than the In plugin. The more stages you replace, the more hyped it gets.
Console8BussHype.use: Swap in place of the matching In plugin. No controls.

Console0Channel.sound: Extremely pure: about eight maths operations per sample. Either you hear it or you don't.
Console0Channel.use: Only for those who buy into the idea. Needs a clean path.

Console0Buss.sound: Extremely pure: about eight maths operations per sample. Either you hear it or you don't.
Console0Buss.use: Only for those who buy into the idea. Needs a clean path.

PurestConsole3Channel.what: An alternate algorithm for minimalist Console (PurestConsole3Channel).
PurestConsole3Channel.sound: A custom sin()/asin() with a near-sin approximation, in the Console Zero line.
PurestConsole3Channel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

PurestConsole3Buss.what: An alternate algorithm for minimalist Console (PurestConsole3Buss).
PurestConsole3Buss.sound: A custom sin()/asin() with a near-sin approximation, in the Console Zero line.
PurestConsole3Buss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

PurestConsole2Channel.sound: Console summing with filtering spread through the chain, as a clean alternative to Console7.
PurestConsole2Channel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

PurestConsole2Buss.sound: Console summing with filtering spread through the chain, as a clean alternative to Console7.
PurestConsole2Buss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

Console7Channel.what: Console7 Console7Channel: anti-alias filtering and saturation curves tied to the slider position.
Console7Channel.sound: Glue and solidity like an analog desk. Ultrasonic filtering is spread through every stage.
Console7Channel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss, unity gain between. Mix with trims, not faders.

Console7Buss.what: Console7 Console7Buss: anti-alias filtering and saturation curves tied to the slider position.
Console7Buss.sound: Glue and solidity like an analog desk. Ultrasonic filtering is spread through every stage.
Console7Buss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss, unity gain between. Mix with trims, not faders.

Console7Cascade.what: A drop-in Console7Channel replacement that allows much higher gain.
Console7Cascade.sound: Five stages of Console7 processing. A consoley crunch that mostly gets intense and loud.
Console7Cascade.use: Slamming drums or channels in a Console7 mix. Heavy on CPU.

controls.Cascade: How hard you drive the five stages.

Console7Crunch.what: Console7Cascade with its filtering order changed for more edge and grit.
Console7Crunch.sound: More crunchy with distorted punch in the extreme highs.
Console7Crunch.use: When you want a grittier high-gain Console7 channel.

controls.Crunch: How hard you drive the stages.

PurestConsoleChannel.sound: Console5-style saturation and anti-saturation, as pure as possible.
PurestConsoleChannel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

PurestConsoleBuss.sound: Console5-style saturation and anti-saturation, as pure as possible.
PurestConsoleBuss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

Console6Channel.what: A more intense Console that peaks at a lower dB (Console6Channel).
Console6Channel.sound: Based on a simple inverse-square encode/decode pair.
Console6Channel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

Console6Buss.what: A more intense Console that peaks at a lower dB (Console6Buss).
Console6Buss.sound: Based on a simple inverse-square encode/decode pair.
Console6Buss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

PDChannel.what: Console5 and PurestDrive in one plugin (PDChannel).
PDChannel.sound: A soft, lush tap with a PurestDrive stage on every channel and the buss.
PDChannel.use: Replace any Console5 plugin of the same type.

PDBuss.what: Console5 and PurestDrive in one plugin (PDBuss).
PDBuss.sound: A soft, lush tap with a PurestDrive stage on every channel and the buss.
PDBuss.use: Replace any Console5 plugin of the same type.

Console5Channel.sound: Warmer and more expensive maths, close to Density or PurestDrive.
Console5Channel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

Console5Buss.sound: Warmer and more expensive maths, close to Density or PurestDrive.
Console5Buss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

Console5DarkCh.sound: Warmer and more expensive maths, close to Density or PurestDrive.
Console5DarkCh.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

C5RawBuss.what: The original Console5 algorithm with optional gentle DC suppression.

AtmosphereChannel.what: Console5 processing with acoustic distance effects (AtmosphereChannel).
AtmosphereChannel.sound: A multi-stage slew clipper that glues and tames digital highs and adds a sense of distance.

AtmosphereBuss.what: Console5 processing with acoustic distance effects (AtmosphereBuss).
AtmosphereBuss.sound: A multi-stage slew clipper that glues and tames digital highs and adds a sense of distance.

Console4Channel.what: The original Airwindows in-the-box mixing system (Console4Channel).
Console4Channel.sound: The first two-plugin mix buss replacement.
Console4Channel.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

Console4Buss.what: The original Airwindows in-the-box mixing system (Console4Buss).
Console4Buss.sound: The first two-plugin mix buss replacement.
Console4Buss.use: Channel on every channel, Buss on the 2-buss.

EveryConsole.what: A mix-and-match Console containing many Console algorithms.
EveryConsole.sound: Console, Console6, Console7, Console8 sin()/asin(), PurestConsole3 and Console Zero, stripped of extras.
EveryConsole.use: Trying Console flavours on a channel.
